Name: (FS) Miss Bodyguards's Wardrobe
Author: Meowskatonic
Description:
保镖小姐们新年快乐！
本模组是我向[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/luoli1119?gameId=1303]洛离[/url]老师约的稿件，包含5套裙子（分成5上衣5下装）+3个发型（头发可自主调色）+2个配饰+3个头饰，欢迎感兴趣的保镖小姐们和老乡们食用。
注：
展示图片中使用的体型模组为桃体 GH's Peach Body type (female)；
参考服饰图片来自游戏《恋与深空》，服饰有属性（《恋与深空》祁煜）

Happy Chinese New Year to all the bodyguard ladies! 
This mod was commissioned by me from the artist [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/luoli1119]@luoli1119[/url], for all the girls who love Rafayel (from [i]Love and Deepspace[/i])!
Includes 5 shirts +  5 pants +  3 hairstyles +  2 accessories + 3 hats (all hairstyles have customizable colors)
Note:
The body type used in the preview images is GH's Peach Body type (female);
the outfit reference images are from [i][i]Love and Deepspace[/i][/i], and the outfits are inspired by Rafayel's style from [i][i]Love and Deepspace[/i][/i].
